text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, greetings. Agnes Tachyon here. 
How is my dear guinea pig feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected, not bad at all. It's a 
pity you aren't an Umamusume, but you make 
a splendid subject for my body 
modification experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"As thanks for your help, let me brew some 
tea. No need to hold back. Drink every 
last drop, and be sure to submit a 
thorough report."

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
